description: This file defines an Angular component named ExpandedTimelineComponent, which displays an expanded view of timeline traces with various UI elements, including icons and nested timeline components. It manages rendering, event handling, and layout adjustments for the timeline visualization.

classes.name: ExpandedTimelineComponent
classes.description: An Angular component that displays multiple timeline traces with accompanying icons and layout controls, supporting resize handling and data-binding.

methods.name: getTraces
methods.description: Returns an array of current Trace objects from the timeline data.

methods.name: onResize
methods.description: Handles window resize events to adjust the canvases accordingly.

methods.name: trackTraceBySelectedTimestamp
methods.description: Tracks the trace by its current timestamp for optimization during change detection.

methods.name: resizeCanvases
methods.description: Resizes all timeline canvases to adapt to layout changes.
